name: Clip Arranger Song Starters
author: Freek van Gool
description: Song starters for Clip Arranger, built on music theory and typical song forms. Every preset is a first configuration for a composition: a handful of tracks with clear roles (drums, bass, chords, pad, arp, lead, percussion, FX), up to eight scenes (intro, verse, chorus, build, drop, break, bridge, outro and so on) with realistic section lengths in bars, and a song arrangement in the order the genre uses (verse-chorus, intro-build-drop-break, AABA, sonata form, rondo and more). Each clip holds a first usable part: a chord progression in a fitting key and mode, a bass figure, a drum pattern, a melody hook, with varied velocities (accents, ghost notes, crescendos), note lengths from staccato to legato, and 1/32 and 1/64 positions for rolls, flams and laid-back timing. No track is wired to a device: connect the Drums and Percussion tracks to a drum machine, Bass to a bass synth, Chords to a polyphonic synth, piano or guitar, Pad to a pad or string synth, Arp to an arpeggio synth, Lead to a lead synth and FX to a drone or effects synth. The tempo and swing to use are named in the song title of each preset; set them on the host transport. Presets start in song arrangement mode.
